nodes.natural_language: Let $n$ be the number of integers $m$ in the range $1\le m\le 8$ such that $\text{gcd}(m,8)=1$. What is the remainder when $3^n$ is divided by $8$? Show that it is 1.
nodes.statement: Let $n$ be the number of integers $m$ in the range $1\le m\le 8$ such that $\text{gcd}(m,8)=1$. What is the remainder when $3^n$ is divided by $8$? Show that it is 1.
